title: World2TS: Real-World Event Context for Time-Series Forecasting

claim.summary: World2TS uses an agent-led, CLI-validated and human-gated workflow to discover, consolidate and ground real-world events to individual series, producing a 31-dataset forecasting corpus with 1,159 events and 56,846 event-series links.

tasks.source_label: Forecasting and prediction; time series annotation

modules.name: Agent-CLI-Human workflow with artifact-bound approval gates
modules.scope_reason: Separating agent judgment from a CLI that executes, validates and keeps resumable state, with human approvals invalidated by later artifact changes, is a domain-independent curation runtime.

modules.scope_reason: Events are linked to series only through explicit semantic rules plus a check that the event interval overlaps each series' temporal coverage, a reusable temporal context alignment independent of the forecasting output.
